Theme

Common words: verbs, qualities & ideas

reflect verb

of a mirror, water or light

also reflection, reflected, mirror image, bounce off

classical

Verg. A. 8.23: lūmen … sōle repercussum
Ov. Met. 3.434: repercussae … imāginis

repercutiō, repercutere, repercussī, repercussum

verb, third conjugation

reflect, throw back (light, an image, a sound)

Lewis & Short: not before Augustus. Mostly in the passive participle: light repercussum, an image repercussa, and of sound, valleys repercussae that echo the shouting (Liv. 21.33.6).

Other words

  • reddō, reddere, reddidī, redditum — give back (light, an image)

    verb, third conjugation · also used · classical · Ov. Met. 2.110: clāra repercussō reddēbant lūmina Phoebō (Lewis & Short)

  • imāgō, imāginis f. — a reflection, an image (in a mirror or water)

    noun, third declension · also used · classical · Varro LL 6.82: speculum, quod in eō specimus imāginem

  • simulācrum, simulācrī n. — a reflection, a likeness

    noun, second declension · also used · classical · Phaedr. 1.4.3: vīdit simulācrum suum; Lucr. 4.98: speculīs appārent simulācra (Lewis & Short)

Examples

  • sīcut aquae tremulum labrīs ubi lūmen aēnīs sōle repercussum aut radiantis imāgine lūnae omnia pervolitat lātē loca, jamque sub aurās ērigitur summīque ferit laqueāria tēctī

    as when the trembling light of water in bronze basins, thrown back by the sun or by the image of the shining moon, flits far and wide over everything, rises into the air and strikes the panels of the ceiling high aboveVerg. A. 8.22–25

  • canis per flūmen carnem cum ferret natāns lymphārum in speculō vīdit simulācrum suum

    a dog swimming across a river with a piece of meat saw his reflection in the mirror of the waterPhaedr. 1.4.2–3

  • ista repercussae, quam cernis, imāginis umbra est

    what you see is the shadow of a reflected imageOv. Met. 3.434

See also mirror, think.
